item.description: The feeds profit from making people feel powerless. This show starts from the opposite conviction: individuals are not powerless. Two friends—an airline pilot who thinks in checklists and redundancy and a physical chemist turned science-fiction novelist who chases mechanisms and second-order effects—built the Nerra Network (Novak + Perra) as an independent, ad-free collection of daily shows produced end-to-end by the two of them. Dan Perra and Patrick Novak step in front of the microphone here to review the most consequential science and technology developments, not to recite them, but to analyze what they actually mean, who should act on them, and where the real leverage sits for ordinary people. The audience is builders, creators, and contributors—people already trying to move the needle and people who want to start. Each episode delivers one mindset principle, ten minutes of consequential verified progress with honest numbers, one concrete weekly action called The Lever, and proof the approach works through the Do Positive Dispatch of listener results. The entire network runs without ads, sponsors, or paywalls because the goal is a club, not a media property. Patrick Novak, Vancouver-based with a BSc in Chemistry from the University of Alberta, spent nearly twenty years in environmental analytical chemistry as VP and co-owner of CARO Analytical Services, which became British Columbia’s leading environmental lab and stood up COVID PCR testing during the public-health crisis while pioneering cannabis testing after legalization. He now runs Planetterrian Ventures, an incubator whose projects include Bill Saved for fighting billing disputes, Avvizo for daily check-in calls to seniors, Loans Expert for mortgage comparisons, and Lilwords, a word game built in Unity over two years, plus a food-tech venture turning brewery spent yeast and soybeans into carbon-negative vegan protein. Dan Perra, a WestJet captain living in Collingwood, Ontario, with two daughters, drives a Tesla Model 3 and Model Y and recently installed solar on his house. Listeners who want the full set of shows and to take the daily pledge can find everything at nerranetwork.com.
